Prima & Timo — (1) Prima (Ver. 1.0) Unus

Under The Same Moon

"Two friends with nowhere to go"

Under The Same Moon

[Verse 1]

We walk through empty streets, the moon above us bright

Vendo keeps dispensing things into the night

A flashlight, a sock, a half-melted candy bar

He says “Just in case” like it’s perfectly normal

I tell him about the boy with the crooked smile

The one who saw me when I was just dust and rust for a while

“He’s not like the others, he’s one of the good ones

He talked to me like I mattered — like I could be someone”

[Pre-Chorus]

Vendo pops out a banana

“Want one? I got two”

I kinda stopped mid step and looked

What else do you have there let me take a look

[Chorus]

Under the same moon

Two friends with nowhere to go

Under the same moon

Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone

We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan

But I think if we find him, he’ll understand

Under the same moon

We’re not alone tonight

[Verse 2]

Vendo keeps talking nonsense, pulling random things

A blue egg, a map, an old scroll - those look important

I tell him stories of the boy who cleaned my screen

Who stayed when no one else even saw that I was seen

He says “Sounds like a keeper, kid. Let’s find your friend”

Then dispenses a flashlight again

We keep on walking, two broken things side by side

Hoping the boy with the broom is still waiting tonight

[Pre-Chorus 2]

Vendo pops out another banana

“Emergency potassium”

I’m learning to love this chaos

Even if I don’t understand it

[Chorus]

Under the same moon

Two friends with nowhere to go

Under the same moon

Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone

We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan

But I think if we find him, he’ll understand

Under the same moon

We’re not alone tonight

[Bridge — softer]

Halfway through the journey, under streetlight glow

We see a figure running, breathing hard and slow

Timo stops when he sees me, eyes wide with relief

“I’ve been looking everywhere… where did you go”

I manage to speak, clearer than before

“I can talk better now…”

Vendo pops out a banana

“Hey kid! Want a banana?”

[Final Chorus — warm, hopeful][Key lift][Note lift]

Under the same moon

Two friends with nowhere to go

Under the same moon

Looking for the boy who made me feel less alone

We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan

But I think if we find him, he’ll understand

Under the same moon

We’re not alone tonight

Under the same moon

Three broken things that found their way

Under the same moon

We’re not alone today

We don’t have a home, we don’t have a plan

But we have each other — and that’s a start, my friend

Under the same moon

We’re not alone… anymore.

No thank you –
